brief:
An Israeli court extended the detention of Gaza physician Adnan Abu Safia without pressing charges against him, nearly two years after Israel's military apprehended him, Al Jazeera English reported. The court's decision came as Abu Safia remained held in Israeli custody since his initial arrest by the army.

Details of the charges or reasons for the extended detention were not immediately disclosed. Abu Safia's case is among thousands of Palestinians held by Israel in the ongoing conflict.
dek: An Israeli court extended the detention of Abu Safia nearly two years after Israel's army detained him.
title: Israeli court extends Gaza doctor's detention without charge
